title: infinity-category
description: A category-like structure with morphisms in every dimension — objects, morphisms, 2-morphisms, and so on — with coherent composition at each level. The quasi-category is its standard presentation; equivalent models are Segal categories and simplicially enriched categories.

coherent-composition.description: composition defined and associative up to higher coherence at every level

presented-by.description: a model presenting the ∞-category, standardly a quasi-category
